capabilities: Add bundled Material-style SVG icons to files and folders in the file explorer
Match icons by filename, compound extension, extension, language-id fallback, and folder name
Adjust icon size, opacity, grayscale, and toggle file or folder icons in settings
Create or remove a neutral-file-tree CSS snippet to suppress theme file-tree colors
Import icon resources from a downloaded release zip when the installer omits them
disambiguation: Not a visual theme; it only decorates the file explorer with icons and does not change the editor's appearance.
extras: The community plugin installer may not install the large icons/ and dist/ resource folders; users must download material-icon-souce.zip from the GitHub release and import it via the plugin settings page.
intentEvidence: adapts the file and folder icon experience from the open-source material-extensions/vscode-material-icon-theme project for the file explorer
problem: Obsidian's file explorer has no built-in file-type icons, and icon styling from other sources can clash with visual themes or break in large vaults.

relations.evidence: This plugin adapts the file and folder icon experience from the open-source material-extensions/vscode-material-icon-theme project

summary: File explorer plugin that adds Material Icon Theme file and folder icons to the vault file tree, with theme-compatible styling.
